section_summary: A despatch dated April 2, 1947 forwards Japanese-language drafts of four bills passed by the 92nd Japanese Diet. The remainder of this section contains one complete copy and the opening pages of a second copy of the bill revising Japan’s inheritance tax law, including its provisions for gift tax.

subfiles.title: Drafts of Four Bills Passed by the 92nd Session of the Japanese Diet
subfiles.about: The Political Adviser forwards Japanese-language copies of four bills passed by the 92nd Diet.
subfiles.summary: Forwards copies of four bills and notes that translations will take considerable time.

subfiles.title: Bill to Amend the Inheritance Tax Law (相続稅法を改正する法律案)
subfiles.about: A proposed revision of inheritance and gift taxation in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The bill defines taxable inheritances and gifts, valuation rules, exemptions, deductions and progressive rates. It sets out filing, payment, assessment, appeal, deferral and payment-in-kind procedures, followed by reporting duties, penalties and transitional provisions. Its closing explanation cites changes in inheritance practices and the adoption of a self-assessment system.

subfiles.title: Bill to Amend the Inheritance Tax Law (相続稅法を改正する法律案), second copy
subfiles.about: A second copy begins the same proposed inheritance and gift tax revision.
subfiles.summary: This copy repeats the bill’s title, contents and opening provisions. Pages 59–80 cover tax liability, deemed inheritances and gifts, trusts, property location, deductions, rates and credits through Article 26. The bill continues beyond this section.
